title: “Immigration officer” says stay on the line
scenario: A caller says your visa record has a mismatch and that leaving the call could trigger enforcement. They know your nationality and university and ask you to verify identity with passport details and a payment.

answers.A: Write down the name, case number and agency, then verify them independently before sharing anything.
answers.B: Stay on the line but refuse payment until they email from an official government domain.
answers.C: End the call and contact the immigration authority and your university international office through official channels.

explanation: Government impostors use fear, specific personal data and isolation. Real authorities can be verified outside the incoming call.
proTip: If an official says you may not hang up, that is a reason to hang up.
